name: Shantakaram
text:
शान्ताकारं भुजगशयनं पद्मनाभं सुरेशं
विश्वाधारं गगनसदृशं मेघवर्णं शुभाङ्गम् ।
लक्ष्मीकान्तं कमलनयनं योगिभिर्ध्यानगम्यं
वन्दे विष्णुं भवभयहरं सर्वलोकैकनाथम् ॥
meaning: I bow to Vishnu, serene and resting upon the serpent, the support of the universe, beloved of Lakshmi, whose presence is contemplated by sages and who removes the fear of worldly existence.
purpose: A contemplative praise of Vishnu’s sustaining and peaceful qualities.
supports: Steadiness; patience; trust; calming fear through contemplation.
when: During meditation or a practice focused on stability.
